scope: Full-budget comparison with the preserved 30-seed run at seed 7098473. Equal physical protocols, pinned numerical libraries and one numerical thread.

default_thread_diagnostic.scope: An earlier direct-API run did not constrain numerical thread counts before NumPy import; its full_budget folder is diagnostic, not the reference reproduction.
default_thread_diagnostic.interpretation: Low-order floating-point differences in linear algebra can change optimization trajectories. The public runner sets all four thread variables before importing numerical libraries.
